name: claim2_transfer_turb_v2
comment: Claim 2: the lab gets better at research, not only at one problem. Turbulence for every arm; researcher mode, vector memory, search off everywhere. Warm arms carry from claim1_ladder_coast arm researcher_memory with the same seed, so run claim 1 first (they wait, marked blocked, until their source has finished). Compare warm against fresh and cheat_sheet; warm_shuffled against warm_notebook (both carry a notebook and no playbook, so only the notebook's content differs).
